details: After a robust August with $3.52 billion in net inflows, US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced a $236.46 million net outflow on September 1st. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for the majority of the selling with a $201.18 million outflow, while Fidelity's FBTC also saw significant withdrawals. This marks a cautious start to September for Bitcoin ETFs, though Ethereum and XRP ETFs continued to see inflows.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $236M Outflow on Sept 1, Ending Strong August Trend

details: On September 1st, while US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded significant outflows, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP spot ETFs saw positive net inflows. Specifically, XRP ETFs led the altcoin category with $14.38 million in fresh inflows, Ethereum attracted $10.95 million, and Solana drew $10.19 million. This indicates a selective institutional demand for alternative digital assets.
title: Altcoin ETFs Gain Traction as Bitcoin Funds Face Sept 1 Outflows

details: Charles Schwab announced plans to add Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK) to its crypto trading platform in the coming months. This expansion will allow its 39.9 million brokerage account holders to trade these altcoins, moving beyond the current Bitcoin and Ethereum offerings, signifying growing mainstream adoption and accessibility for a broader range of digital assets.
title: Charles Schwab to Offer SOL, AVAX, LINK Trading to Millions

details: The U.S. Senate is scheduled to hold a procedural cloture vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act on September 15th. This vote is crucial to determine if the bill, which aims to establish a clear regulatory framework for digital assets, can advance to a full floor debate. Passing requires 60 votes, and several issues, including ethics rules and DeFi developer liability, remain contentious.
title: Senate Faces Critical CLARITY Act Vote on Sept 15 for Crypto Regulation

details: Grayscale suggests cryptocurrencies could serve as a valuable diversification tool for portfolios, especially as U.S. households hold a record proportion of their financial assets in stocks with historically high valuations. The firm notes that after a prolonged bear market, the crypto market has seen reduced valuations and leverage, potentially signaling a new recovery cycle.
title: Grayscale Pitches Crypto as Portfolio Diversifier Amid High Stock Valuations
